description.value: The Inn at Tough City is a distinctive waterfront boutique hotel in Tofino built largely from salvaged materials, including over 45,000 bricks from Vancouver's Gastown and stained-glass windows imported from Scotland. Its 8 individually decorated rooms look directly onto Clayoquot Sound, and the property includes an eclectic on-site sushi bar with an extensive menu of fresh local seafood. Founded roughly 30 years ago by 'Crazy Ron' and Johanna Vanderkley, the Inn is known for its relaxed, home-style atmosphere that stands apart from chain or resort hotels.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at toughcity.com is live and confirms an operating boutique hotel at 350 Main Street, Tofino, overlooking Clayoquot Sound, with 8 individually designed rooms and an on-site sushi restaurant. The site makes no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific amenities, so all those fields default to null. The links page ('Friends of The Inn') names several nearby restaurants including Schooner Restaurant, SoBo, and Common Loaf, providing positive evidence of nearby evening food; no phone number appears in either OSM or the website content.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM tags or anywhere on the website.
